description: Buy a product from a Solinkify Blink link as shared on X. Moves money: settles on Solana through the same escrow rails as DataHub and returns the receipt plus the download link. The price is read from the catalog and checked against the spending caps first.

email.description: Optional buyer e-mail for the receipt. Leave it out to buy anonymously; the download link is returned either way.

url.description: Share link, Actions URL, or raw product id of the Blink to buy, in the same forms social_get_blink accepts.

name: social_buy_blink
